modules.title_verbatim: Develop good appearance and behaviour, practice tasks as per industry standard and express good communication skill following safety precautions.
Prepare and maintain work area and maintain health and safety at the workplace.
Carry out epilation and depilation services. Illustrate and explain hair structure & hair growth cycle.
Carry out manicure and pedicure services. Explain anatomy of nail. Differentiate and identify nail disease nail disorders.
Carry out facial treatments for common skin problems. Illustrate and explain skin structure.
Carry out hair treatment for common hair problems. Illustrate and explain structure of hair.
Create basic haircuts using special cutting techniques.
Demonstrate basic yogic exercises for stamina building and correcting body posture.
Demonstrate day, evening, party & bridal makeup and explain effects of light on makeup.
Create traditional hair styles & hair designing with artificial aids and thermal gadgets.
Demonstrate hair colouring, perming, straightening, re-bonding & smoothening. Explain the knowledge of bonds.
Create bindi, heena & temporary tattoo designing, drape saree in different styles.

records.title_verbatim: HIGHER NITEC IN BEAUTY & WELLNESS MANAGEMENT (2 YEARS)
records.entry_as_published: GCE 'O' level grades 1-7 in English Language and two other subjects; applicants must have sat for Mathematics; or eligible Nitec GPA pathway. A prescribed medical examination is required.

modules.outcome_verbatim: On completion of this module, students should be able to provide day, evening, and camouflage makeup.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform manicure and pedicure service, and provide hand and foot massage.
On completion of this module, students should be able to provide basic facial treatment and shape eyebrows.
On completion of this module, students should be able to prepare and execute e-marketing plans on social media platforms.
On completion of this module, students should be able to manage customer’s needs, wants, expectations and feedback, promote products and services, and provide service recovery to customers.
On completion of this module, students should be able to provide bridal, stage and photography makeup.
On completion of this module, students should be able to conduct client consultation and recommend healthy diet and lifestyle plan.
On completion of this module, students should be able to blend essential oils and provide aromatherapy facial treatment.
On completion of this module, students should be able to extract skin blockages and provide electrical facial treatments.

On completion of this module, students should be able to provide electrotherapy for facial deep cleaning, skin tightening and lifting treatments and provide microdermabrasion for the face and neck area.
On completion of this module, students should be able to provide nail services, nail art, nail extensions and infills.
On completion of this module, students should be able to provide electrotherapy treatments. For body toning/firming and slimming.
On completion of this module, students should be able to prepare formulations for cosmetic products.
On completion of this module, students should be able to apply the skills and knowledge acquired to take on a range of job scope at the company.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform hair removal waxing treatments.
On completion of this module, students should be able to perform upstyles.
